formal.scope: Synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

independentAudit.method: Original input safety gates and independent edge ordinals define the model-to-active clock mapping. Active held intervals intersect public hold ranges; first eligible fresh edges match disjoint closed windows. Completed woven flags determine crossings, streak runs, triangular chain bonus and the first segment-boundary terminal. All actual frames, interval summaries and receipt copies are compared without Model/pilot import, gameplay or per-tick rhythm-state replay.
limitations: Only the root-approved first six public ordinary cases. Formal synthetic boundaries, browser dual-pointer input, host pause/disconnect/retry and video remain separate evidence.

All model ticks, including initial neutral acknowledgement and preparation, are retained. Cancel reentry, invalid axes, pressed aliases and post-terminal/invalid-dt calls are checked only if actually present; none are synthesized.
Active-clock held continuity excludes frozen recovery calls exactly as the public rules require. Recovery-zero calls remain non-running; preparation edges consume ordinals without matching a pulse.

Serialized observations prove values and historical copies, not object identity or Object.freeze. Only tapReceipts and segmentReceipts are prefix-encoded; mutable segment progress remains fully observed.
Integer windows, hold counts, edge identities, scores and terminal gates use zero tolerance. Model and active elapsed values are separately derived from the public 60 Hz unit.

Observed coverage counts do not turn absent boundary cases into ordinary evidence. Original raw/source hashes are bound through the approved projection without reading diagnostic-bearing originals or production implementation.

gameRules.scope: Formal isolated boundaries, six ordinary-input games and independent two-clock audit are separate evidence; no full input/rhythm replay in packaging.

modelTests.scope: Synthetic rule-boundary tests against the frozen public contract. No complete ordinary route, private author witness, browser execution, rendering performance, or physical-device testing is claimed.

cancel and incomplete neutral freeze activeTick; complete neutral exposes preparation and consumes preparation taps without hits
disconnect freezes the full model; stale held input cannot bypass neutral and preparation after reconnect

ordinary L1 hold-both naturally loses after three actually frayed segments, without repeated fresh hits
R restores the same public braid, empty results and a fresh neutral/preparation gate
separate QR room-info layout fixture fits complete text at both TV sizes

performance.note: Intervals between observer RAF callbacks on this browser; not render CPU time or device FPS. WebGL multi_draw counts API submissions, not its subdraws. Canvas paint commands are not GPU draw calls. OffscreenCanvas workers are not observed.

ordinaryBraidManagement.scope: Actual A/B keyboard dispatch edges, permanent tap/segment receipts and sparse two-clock, held-input and braid endpoints. Wall-clock dispatch intervals do not reconstruct active hold durations or prove a physical controller. Complete saved receipts may include transient last events never sampled; those gaps remain explicit. Observed lastStep values are actual calls, including gated preparation and terminal calls. No missing input, hold check, hit or model interval is replayed. Real controller-page two-pointer/WebSocket integration and ordinary independent audit remain separate evidence.

encodingOrderEvidence.scope: Original reception order and frame bytes retained; encoding order is stable by actual recorded timestamp with reception-index ties. Consolidation synthesizes no state or frame.

actualGameplay.observationScope: Actual browser input, permanent tap/segment receipts and sparse model-time, active-time, held-input and braid observations. Wall-clock key dispatch intervals are not active hold durations. Missing local events and sample gaps remain explicit; no input or rhythm replay occurs. The ordinary independent audit is separate. The approved recipe, observed win and at least eleven seconds of actual terminal hold are bound. Actual controller-page two-pointer/WebSocket integration is separately recorded alongside controlled TV-bridge fixtures; neither proves physical hardware. Original reception order, derived encoding mapping and real empty error arrays remain factual. The existing full decode is reused once; no recording recovery is assumed.

controllerTransportEvidence.scope: Browser-emulated two touch contacts produce trusted PointerEvents on the unchanged signed-asset controller.html/js; the controlled WebSocket server records actual outgoing strings. This checks the controller transport independently of the separately declared TV input-bridge/model checks, not physical phone hardware or a production Android server.

actualGameplay.browserScope: Actual controller page/WS transport is separate from controlled TV input-bridge/model checks. The QR data is a layout fixture; no physical hardware or Android end-to-end link is claimed.

finalExecutionHistory.scope: UI continuation and first QR/record/media execution; shared evidence is separately bound to its original closed window.

sharedEvidenceWindow.scope: These seven unchanged shared10 artifacts were executed only in the first source window; this continuation does not rerun shared QA.

uiAttemptHistory.firstFailureStage: unchanged controller page sends independent two-pointer hold/tap and cancel packets through a real local WebSocket
uiAttemptHistory.failureReason: Third semantic edge requested B release while A stayed held; actual touchMove produced no trusted pointerup and no corresponding WS A-only packet before timeout.
uiAttemptHistory.scope: First UI failed at controller partial release; all evidence retained. Shared10 belongs only to the original closed window. Corrected UI and first QR/record/media belong to the separate continuation window.

liveWindows.name: 05-actual-left-hold-and-tap-progress
liveWindows.scope: Real continuous before/after window preserving the actual held lane. Rhythm, segment progress and terminal phase may advance naturally; the tap key is already released and rearmed. Capture issues no input. Receipts prove earlier hits/crossings, not an instantaneous screenshot event. Neither endpoint substitutes for pixels; no pause, state injection or time freeze.

candidateEvidence.scope: Personally opened these 12 original PNGs, not every gameplay frame. Live pixels and adjacent actual observations are continuous time-window evidence; modest HUD/canvas refresh differences are not asserted to be identical instants. Native Enter proves the recorded keyboard path only; real controller-page two-pointer/WebSocket integration remains a later dedicated UI check, and no physical phone/TV claim is made. Raw candidate report flags remain false and untouched.

metadataProjection.scope: Metadata projection only. No new review, capture, source window or acceptance; all original conclusions and timestamps remain unchanged.

hardware.note: Software Chromium with ordinary input. Synthetic fixtures are labelled separately; export FPS is not device FPS.
